objects.query: SELECT Id, StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Id, Name, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Code, Id, Name FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code IN ('ENT_NAMED_USERS', 'ENT_TOTAL_NAMED_USERS') ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Id, IsActive, IsStandard, Name FROM Pricebook2 WHERE IsStandard = true
SELECT AdjustmentMethod, Id, IsActive, Name, ScheduleType FROM PriceAdjustmentSchedule ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, Id, IsActive, IsDerived, Name, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC

SELECT AdjustmentType, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Id, LowerBound, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, TierType, TierValue, UpperBound, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PriceAdjustmentTier WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, LowerBound ASC
SELECT Id, Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjRule WHERE Name LIKE 'ENT-%' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeDefinitionId, Id, StringValue, Operator, ProductId, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, AttributeDefinition.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM AttributeAdjustmentCondition WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'ENT-%' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Operator ASC, StringValue ASC

SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Id, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, ProductId, ProductSellingModelId, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjustment WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'ENT-%' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC

SELECT ContributingProductId, CurrencyIsoCode, DerivedPricingScope, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Formula, Id, PricebookEntryId, PricebookId, PricingSource, ProductId, ProductSellingModelId, ContributingProduct.StockKeepingUnit, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntryDerivedPrice WHERE Product.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ContributingProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC
